q: The International Court of Justice has how many judges, and where does it sit?
x: 15 judges with 9-year terms, at The Hague in the Netherlands.

q: Which of these is NOT a permanent member of the UN Security Council?
x: The P5: USA, UK, France, Russia and China.

q: Where is the head office of UNESCO?
Where is the head office of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)?
x: FAO is in Rome, as are IFAD and the World Food Programme.

q: How many members does NATO have now?
x: Finland joined in 2023 (31st) and Sweden in 2024 (32nd).

q: Which country joined ASEAN in 2025 as its 11th member?
x: Timor-Leste became the 11th ASEAN member in October 2025.
BIMSTEC is in Dhaka. The SAARC secretariat is in Kathmandu.

q: Who publishes the Human Development Report?
x: The UN Development Programme publishes the HDI every year.

q: Who publishes the Global Gender Gap Report?
Which became India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2026?
x: Sarnath (2026). Maratha Military Landscapes were the 44th (2025); Moidams the 43rd (2024).

q: Where was the 18th BRICS summit held?
x: New Delhi, September 2026, under India's chairship. 17th: Rio (2025); 16th: Kazan (2024).

q: Which country hosted the G20 summit in 2025?
x: Johannesburg, South Africa, the first G20 summit in Africa. 2024: Brazil; 2023: India; 2026: USA.

q: Where is the head office of the International Solar Alliance?
x: Gurugram, India. The ISA was launched by India and France in 2015; IRENA is in Abu Dhabi.

q: Which UN body has its head office in Nairobi?
x: UNEP (and UN-Habitat) are in Nairobi. UNICEF = New York; WFP = Rome; UNHCR = Geneva.
